title: Database tables
description: Exact row counts and on-disk size of each public table, including indexes. Size keeps space left after deletes until the table is rewritten.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.relname AS tabela, (xpath('/row/cnt/text()', query_to_xml(format('SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM %I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint AS rekordy, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS rozmiar FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relkind = 'r' ORDER BY rekordy DESC, c.relname
SELECT c.relname AS tabela, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS rozmiar FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relkind = 'r' ORDER BY rozmiar DESC
